mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations and leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns. FEDFUNDS <= 1.0% defines the failure threshold.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 1.0% and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL readings above 245 indicate high inflation, triggering market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 245 and 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 245, market anticipates aggressive rate hikes, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to recession fears.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 245 and 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%) trigger recession fears and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST readings above 1200 (thousands of units) indicate strong housing market activity, signaling robust consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 470,000 million dollars and employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 145,000 thousand persons, the economy is in a strong growth phase, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 470000 and PAYEMS > 145000 and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market, leading to strong economic growth and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.
